nodes.text: [i]It sounds younger now. Its pages are shaking.[/i]

nodes.speaker: The Spoiler
nodes.text: If I don't tell him how it ends, he'll find out alone. That's worse. That's always worse.
[i]You hold up the lantern. The torn page drifts down out of the book and lands in your hand, blank.[/i]
[i]It was never torn out. It was never written. That was the whole secret: there was never a last page, only a boy who was afraid to find out.[/i]
